deck.variables.ptrX = my.layout.x
deck.variables.ptrY = my.layout.y
local tapReady = false
local holdLocked = false
local dragClickActive = false

-- tap / hold
local HOLD_TIME = 0.4
local MOVE_THRESHOLD = 0.4   -- tap/hold cancel distance
local STILL_THRESHOLD_SQ = MOVE_THRESHOLD * MOVE_THRESHOLD
local LOCK_SPEED = 0.3       -- cursor speed multiplier while tap/hold still possible (1 = normal, 0 = frozen)

-- visual offset so the arrow tip sits on ptrX/ptrY (at base size)
local OFF_X, OFF_Y = 0, 0.1

-- shake to grow
local BASE_SIZE = 0.25       -- default cursor size
local SHAKE_MIN = 0.5        -- min back-and-forth travel to count as a reversal
local SHAKE_COUNT = 6        -- reversals needed on one axis...
local SHAKE_WINDOW = 0.7     -- ...within this many seconds
local SHAKE_HOLD = 0.3       -- keep growing this long after last detected reversal
local GROW_RATE = 1.5        -- exponential growth per second while shaking (no max)
local SHRINK_SPEED = 8       -- how fast it returns to normal
local MAX_SCALE = 3          -- set a number to cap, e.g. 20
local DEBUG = false          -- print scale while shaking

local time = 0
local scale = 1
local shakeUntil = 0

local axX = { pos = 0, ext = 0, dir = 0, times = {} }
local axY = { pos = 0, ext = 0, dir = 0, times = {} }

local function resetAxis(a)
  a.pos, a.ext, a.dir = 0, 0, 0
  a.times = {}
end

-- reversal = pulling back SHAKE_MIN from the extreme
local function trackAxis(a, d)
  a.pos = a.pos + d
  if a.dir == 0 then
    if a.pos - a.ext >= SHAKE_MIN then
      a.dir = 1
      a.ext = a.pos
    elseif a.ext - a.pos >= SHAKE_MIN then
      a.dir = -1
      a.ext = a.pos
    end
  elseif a.dir == 1 then
    if a.pos > a.ext then
      a.ext = a.pos
    elseif a.ext - a.pos >= SHAKE_MIN then
      a.times[#a.times + 1] = time
      a.dir = -1
      a.ext = a.pos
    end
  else
    if a.pos < a.ext then
      a.ext = a.pos
    elseif a.pos - a.ext >= SHAKE_MIN then
      a.times[#a.times + 1] = time
      a.dir = 1
      a.ext = a.pos
    end
  end
end

local function axisShaking(a)
  while #a.times > 0 and a.times[1] < time - SHAKE_WINDOW do
    table.remove(a.times, 1)
  end
  return #a.times >= SHAKE_COUNT
end

function onCreate()
  deck.variables.ptrF = 1
end

function onUpdate(dt)
  time = time + dt
  if not holdLocked then
    deck.variables.ptrC = 0
  end
  local touches = castle.getTouches()
  if #touches > 0 then
    local t1 = touches[1]
    if t1.pressed then
      tapReady = true
      holdLocked = false
      dragClickActive = false
      resetAxis(axX)
      resetAxis(axY)
    end
    if #touches >= 2 then
      local t2 = touches[2]
      if t2.pressed then
        deck.variables.ptrC = 3
        tapReady = false
        holdLocked = false
        dragClickActive = false
      end
    else
      if tapReady and not holdLocked then
        local dx = t1.x - t1.initialX
        local dy = t1.y - t1.initialY
        if (dx * dx + dy * dy) > STILL_THRESHOLD_SQ then
          tapReady = false
        elseif t1.duration >= HOLD_TIME then
          holdLocked = true
          deck.variables.ptrC = 2
        end
      end

      if holdLocked and not dragClickActive then
        if t1.deltaX ~= 0 or t1.deltaY ~= 0 then
          deck.variables.ptrSX = deck.variables.ptrX
          deck.variables.ptrSY = deck.variables.ptrY
          dragClickActive = true
        end
      end

      if t1.released then
        if holdLocked then
          holdLocked = false
          deck.variables.ptrC = 0
          dragClickActive = false
        elseif tapReady then
          deck.variables.ptrC = 1
        end
        tapReady = false
      end
    end

    trackAxis(axX, t1.deltaX)
    trackAxis(axY, t1.deltaY)

    -- slow while a tap/hold is still possible
    local speed = (tapReady and not holdLocked) and LOCK_SPEED or 1
    deck.variables.ptrX = deck.variables.ptrX + t1.deltaX * speed
    deck.variables.ptrY = deck.variables.ptrY + t1.deltaY * speed
  end

  -- shake to grow: keeps growing while shaking, no max by default
  if axisShaking(axX) or axisShaking(axY) then
    shakeUntil = time + SHAKE_HOLD
  end
  if time < shakeUntil then
    scale = math.min(MAX_SCALE, scale + scale * GROW_RATE * dt)
    if DEBUG then print("shake scale", scale) end
  else
    scale = scale + (1 - scale) * math.min(1, dt * SHRINK_SPEED)
  end
  my.layout.widthScale = BASE_SIZE * scale
  my.layout.heightScale = BASE_SIZE * scale

  -- offset scales with size so the tip stays on the pointer
  deck.variables.ptrX = math.clamp(deck.variables.ptrX, -5, 4.9)
  deck.variables.ptrY = math.clamp(deck.variables.ptrY, -7, 6.9)
  
  my.layout.x = deck.variables.ptrX + OFF_X * scale
  my.layout.y = deck.variables.ptrY + OFF_Y * scale
  my.drawing.currentFrame = deck.variables.ptrF
end
